title: Keep-out zones
description: A 150x100x40mm enclosure has two keep-out regions no component may intersect: a mounting boss occupying x 65-85, y 40-60, full height; and a cable channel along the front edge occupying x 0-150, y 0-10, full height. Place m1 (60x40x30mm), m2 (60x40x30mm), m3 (40x30x20mm), m4 (40x30x20mm) fully inside, no overlaps, no rotation, avoiding both keep-outs. Return the min-corner [x,y,z] of each in millimeters.
